name: YouTube Music Break Music
author: KHost
description: Plays break music through YouTube Music on this machine: the app installed in Microsoft Edge on Windows, or KHost's own YouTube Music app on macOS.

settings.label: Playlist (YouTube Music link — blank resumes whatever the app has loaded)
Open YouTube Music if it is not already running
Fade length in milliseconds: down on pause and when a singer starts, up on play and resume (0 cuts at once)
Press play again when YouTube Music pauses by itself ("Are you still there?")
Edge profile folder for YouTube Music, Windows only (blank uses KHost's own)
